hero.title: Build Software People Pay to Use.
hero.desc: Multi-tenant platforms with the parts that make software sellable: isolation between customers, authentication, roles, subscriptions, administration and analytics.

disappoint.title: The Hard Parts Of SaaS Are Not The Features
disappoint.desc: Off-the-shelf tools work until your process differs from the product's assumptions. Then the workarounds become the operation.
problems: Tenant data separation was not designed at the start.
Roles and permissions do not match how customers organize teams.
Billing, trials and plan changes are handled manually.
There is no admin surface to support customers.

solution.title: A Platform Designed To Be Sold
solution.desc: We architect tenancy, identity and billing first, then build the product on top. Organizations, invitations, roles, plans, usage and administration are part of the platform rather than later additions.
